== Course of events ==

After Old Mombi's magic left the party wandering among a field of giant sunflowers with girls' faces, the group escaped by riding forward with their eyes closed, following Jack Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse. This escape freed the travelers from the sunflower field and allowed them to resume their journey. It was followed by the Scarecrow's attempt to navigate by the sun, during which the Saw-Horse stepped into a rabbit hole and broke its leg.
